mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate from the prior month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the months where FEDFUNDS declines from the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the months where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending, which together signal an impending economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when the interaction (UNRATE rising and RSAFS falling) occurs but the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of such instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an economic slowdown that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the months where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units, it signals a weakening construction sector and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the months where HOUST falls below 1200, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index) signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the months where INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the months where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals persistent inflation, which leads to a monetary tightening cycle and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the months where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 24-month rolling window.
